title: QuickBooks books part revenue by the line's category
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Use staging with the QuickBooks sandbox connected, and sign in to that QuickBooks sandbox in a second browser window.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35, mapped in Settings › Categories to a QuickBooks item for this test, item A.
  • Have a new category for this test, category B, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix B, with , mapped to a different QuickBooks item, item B.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new inventory part for this test at your location, in category A, cost $100.00.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer B, made after customer B's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1), with that inventory part on line 1, its line category changed to category B, invoiced and synced.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the invoice in the QuickBooks sandbox.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 shows the part in category B.

Step 2:

  • The QuickBooks line uses item B (category B, the line's category), not item A (category A, the part's own category).
